name: manual_9fe181
claim: Only operator-confirmed decisions may be recorded as decided: a document that calls unratified gates ratified must be corrected before publication, and the correction travels with the record.

decisions.notes: A D-0 decision record marked every gate accepted based on an over-broad reading of an operator directive; the operator-confirmed gate record showed only one gate plus the slice premise decided, and the record was corrected the same day.

rationale: A D-0 decision record marked every gate accepted based on an over-broad reading of an operator directive; the operator-confirmed gate record showed only one gate plus the slice premise decided, and the record was corrected the same day.
